subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: After cross-process package cleanup is made safe, should this PR land with the current remove-and-delete provenance model, or must the Claws RFC first define and retain a redacted removal tombstone?
rationale: The code can mechanically fix the race, but only maintainers can choose the permanent destructive lifecycle, audit, and upgrade contract while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Require RFC acceptance and tombstone
options.body: Pause this lifecycle slice until the RFC is accepted and removal retains a redacted durable audit record for the deleted agent and owned resources.

options.title: Accept deletion without tombstone
options.body: Approve complete provenance deletion after successful removal, provided cross-process package ownership serialization and upgrade tests are added.

options.title: Land read-only status first
options.body: Split out authoritative status and defer destructive removal until the lifecycle and audit contract settles.

recommendation.title: Require RFC acceptance and tombstone
recommendation.body: Pause this lifecycle slice until the RFC is accepted and removal retains a redacted durable audit record for the deleted agent and owned resources.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible product-model reviewer whose requested agent-centric lifecycle now defines this stack.
